meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目历史按周生成连续叙事回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把项目记录自动整理成每周连续的叙事摘要
copy.tagline_en: Turn your project timeline into a week-by-week narrative.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automatic weekly narrative summaries of your project history.

howto.what: Claude 先把项目完整时间线按 ISO 周拆成独立文件,再按周顺序逐个生成叙事章节,每章继承上一章的交接信息,最终输出多章系列摘要和每周索引表。
howto.when: 当用户要求按周拆分的连续叙事,如“weekly digests”、“week-by-week story”、“serial timeline”等时触发。

say.text: 请为这个项目生成每周摘要
say.note: 会按周拆分时间线,依次生成各周章节。

say.text: 我要按周看项目进展故事
say.note: 触发连续叙事,每周一章。

say.text: 把这个项目从开始到现在的历史按周做成连续章节
say.note: 章节会继承上一周的交接信息。

howto.what_en: Splits the project's full timeline into per-ISO-week files and generates one narrative digest chapter per week, each inheriting the previous week's carry-forward block, resulting in a serial multi-chapter story plus a weekly index table.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for 'weekly digests', 'week-by-week story', 'serial timeline', or similar requests for a per-week narrative breakdown of a project's history.

say_en.text: Make weekly digests for this project
say_en.note: Splits the timeline into weeks and generates chapters sequentially.

say_en.text: Show me the project's story week by week
say_en.note: Serial narrative, one chapter per ISO week.

say_en.text: Run a digest for each week from start to now
say_en.note: Chapters inherit prior carry-forward for continuity.
